messages:
harry: heads-up — noticed increased hallucination-rate (approx +6% absolute) and a small throughput drop after v5.2.0 rolled to private clusters in usw2. hosted and shared pools are fine. auto-rollback for private clusters is disabled. do we want a manual targeted rollback for private only?

deploy-bot: signal summary: cohort=private, region=usw2, hallucination_delta=6.1%, throughput_drop=8%, window=11m. suggestion: targeted rollback to v5.1.7 for private clusters. example command: `/deploy rollback --to v5.1.7 --cohort=private --regions=usw2 --slice=40% --pin=20m`
nina: +1 for manual targeted rollback. customers on private clusters are high-touch; prefer staged 40 -> 80 -> 100 with quick smoke checks. also request `--preserve-sessions` to avoid session churn.
len: oncall — agree. note: change window ends in 30m; we should complete before then. also ask to add telemetry tag rollback_cause=hallucination so analytics can pick it up.
harry: ok @deploy-bot start a 40% private-slice rollback with preserve-sessions and kv-warm=3m. pin for 20m.
deploy-bot: executing:
```
/deploy rollback --to v5.1.7 --cohort=private --regions=usw2 --slice=40% --pin=20m --preserve-sessions=true --warm-kv=3m --tag=rollback_cause:hallucination
```
Estimated 80s. will return health checks.
deploy-bot: 40% slice complete. hallucination_delta reduced to 1.0%, throughput back to baseline for the slice. awaiting approval to proceed to 80%.
nina: proceed to 80% please. I'll monitor eval-suite (semantic-stability + hallucination-check).
deploy-bot: increasing slice to 80% (graceful drain 45s).
deploy-bot: 80% done. health stable. ready for final 100% on approval.
harry: go final 100%.
deploy-bot: rollback to v5.1.7 completed across private clusters in usw2. traffic pinned to v5.1.7 for 20m. KV warm window active. health summary: hallucination_rate back to baseline, throughput restored.
pm-bot: drafting customer-facing note and adding a short blurb to release notes: "Private clusters rolled back to v5.1.7 due to increased hallucination rate observed in canary. Hosted/shared pools unchanged. Monitoring ongoing." ticket INF-5021 opened and linked.
len: thanks, team. action items: 1) nina to own RCA and evaluation harness addition, 2) infra to consider a private-auto-rollback flag for future, 3) pm to notify affected customers.
nina: will create RCA doc, include timestamps and eval diffs, and assign follow-ups.
harry: closing coordination here — good job. :white_check_mark:
